{{Quote|That was the hardest thing I've ever done. Next time, Sir, can I volunteer for snatch heavily armed Wookiee psychopaths? It'd be a lot easier on my nerves.|Wirut, on arresting Cal Omas|<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
'''Wirut''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. He also served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[967 Commando]], a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] GAG [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], he [[Solo-Niathal coup|arrested]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]]&mdash;leader of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]&mdash;at the behest of Solo. Although Wirut harbored reservations about [[Prisoner/Legends|arresting]] the Galactic Alliance head of state, he nonetheless complied with his [[Commander/Legends|commander's]] orders.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
